name: Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications
certifications: Oracle Cloud Applications Certified Implementation Professional exams (Financials, HCM and SCM tracks, renewed each year)
Oracle AI Agent Studio for Fusion Applications learning paths

beginner.summary: For functional consultants, key users, analysts and developers who are starting with Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications. Covers the ERP, HCM and SCM pillars and the quarterly update cycle, Redwood navigation, enterprise structures, Setup and Maintenance, roles and security, General Ledger, Payables and Receivables, procurement, HCM core and processes, absence, time and compensation, inventory and order management, approvals, OTBI and BI Publisher reporting, data import with FBDI and HCM Data Loader, REST APIs, update readiness and the embedded AI agents.
prerequisites: Understands basic business processes such as purchasing, invoicing or hiring
Comfortable with spreadsheets and web applications
outcomes: Navigate Fusion and explain its pillars, enterprise structures and security model
Run core finance, procurement, HCM and supply chain transactions
Build OTBI analyses and BI Publisher reports and load data with FBDI and HCM Data Loader
Prepare for quarterly updates and use the embedded AI agents

days.topic: Oracle Fusion Overview: Pillars, Modules and the Quarterly Update Cycle
subtopics: Fusion Cloud Applications as SaaS on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
The ERP, HCM, SCM and CX pillars
Functional and technical roles in a Fusion project
Oracle documentation, release notes and Cloud Customer Connect
Course project overview: a services company moving to Fusion
days.lab_task: Tour a Fusion training environment, find one page from each pillar, open the release readiness content for the current update and map the modules the course company needs.
days.deliverable: Module map for the course company
checks: One page from each pillar is located
Needed modules are listed with reasons
The quarterly update cycle is explained correctly

days.topic: Navigation Basics: Redwood Pages, Home, Worklist and Search
subtopics: Redwood pages compared with classic pages
days.lab_task: Sign in to the training environment, find a supplier, an employee and an item with global search, act on a worklist notification and personalise the home page.
checks: Supplier, employee and item are found
The home page shows chosen quick actions

days.topic: Enterprise Structures: Legal Entities, Business Units and Ledgers
subtopics: Ledgers, charts of accounts and calendars
Designing structures for the course company
days.lab_task: Design legal entities, business units, a ledger and reference data sets for the course company with the Enterprise Structures Configurator and review them with a peer.
checks: Legal entities, business units and ledger match the company
Reference data sets are assigned correctly
A peer confirms the design against requirements

days.topic: Setup and Maintenance: Offerings, Functional Areas and Task Lists
days.lab_task: Enable the Financials and Procurement offerings, opt in to two features, create an implementation project and complete three setup tasks in order.
checks: The implementation project lists the tasks
Three tasks are completed in order

days.topic: Users, Roles and Security: Job, Duty and Data Roles
subtopics: Role types: job, abstract, duty and data roles
Data security and data access sets
days.lab_task: Create users for a buyer, an accountant and a manager, give them roles through provisioning rules and check what each can see and do.
days.deliverable: Users with roles and an access check
checks: Each user sees only allowed data

days.topic: Financials Core: General Ledger, Journals and Period Close
days.lab_task: Enter and approve journals, run an allocation, close a period for the course ledger and produce a trial balance.
checks: The period closes and the trial balance balances

days.topic: Payables and Receivables: Invoices, Payments and Receipts
days.lab_task: Match supplier invoices to purchase orders, release a hold, pay suppliers, create customer invoices and apply a receipt, then check the accounting.
days.deliverable: Payables and receivables transactions with accounting
checks: The receipt is applied to the invoice
Subledger entries post to the ledger

days.topic: Procurement: Requisitions, Purchase Orders and Suppliers
days.lab_task: Register a supplier, raise a requisition from a catalogue, approve and create the purchase order, receive the goods and follow the flow to the invoice.
checks: The supplier is approved for use
The requisition becomes an approved purchase order
Receipt and invoice match the order

days.topic: HCM Core: Workforce Structures, Persons and Assignments
days.lab_task: Create jobs, grades, positions and departments for the course company, hire two employees with assignments and view them as their manager.
checks: Jobs, grades, positions and departments exist
The manager sees the team in My Team

days.topic: HCM Processes: Hire, Transfer, Terminate and Approvals
days.lab_task: Run a hire with an onboarding journey, a promotion with approval, a transfer and a termination, and review the audit history.
checks: The new hire receives the onboarding journey
The promotion waits for and gets approval
All changes appear in the audit history

days.topic: Absence, Time and Compensation Essentials
days.lab_task: Set up an absence plan with accruals, record leave and time cards, and run an individual compensation change with a salary basis.
checks: Time cards are submitted and approved

days.topic: Supply Chain Core: Items, Inventory and Order Management
days.lab_task: Create items, receive stock into a subinventory, enter a sales order, ship it and check inventory balances.
checks: Items exist in the inventory organisation
Inventory balances reflect receipt and shipment

days.topic: Approvals and Workflow: Approval Rules and Notifications
days.lab_task: Configure approval rules for requisitions by amount and for promotions by grade, test them with three cases and set a vacation rule.
checks: Each case reaches the right approver

days.topic: Reporting with OTBI: Subject Areas, Analyses and Dashboards
days.lab_task: Build OTBI analyses for open purchase orders and headcount by department with prompts, put them on a dashboard and share it.
checks: Users with the right roles open the dashboard

days.topic: BI Publisher Reports and Scheduled Processes
days.lab_task: Build a BI Publisher report with a SQL data model and an RTF template for supplier payments, schedule it and deliver it by email.
checks: The report shows correct payment data

days.topic: Data Import: FBDI, HCM Data Loader and Spreadsheets
subtopics: Loading interface tables and import jobs
days.lab_task: Load suppliers with FBDI, workers with HCM Data Loader and journals with a spreadsheet, fix the errors and reload.
checks: The method choice is justified for each object

days.topic: Fusion REST APIs and Integration Patterns
subtopics: REST APIs for ERP, HCM and SCM
Oracle Integration as the integration platform
days.lab_task: Read and update suppliers and workers with REST APIs, subscribe to a business event and sketch an integration design for a payroll provider.
days.deliverable: API calls and an integration sketch
checks: An API update appears in the application
The integration pattern is chosen with reasons

days.topic: Quarterly Updates: Release Readiness, Opt-In Features and Regression Testing
subtopics: Features on by default and opt-in features
Update schedules for test and production pods
days.lab_task: Review the next update's new features for the course modules, choose which to opt in to, write a regression test plan and run five test cases.
days.deliverable: Update impact review and regression test results
checks: Relevant new features are listed with impact
Five regression tests run with results

days.topic: AI in Fusion: Embedded AI, Role-Based Agents and AI Agent Studio
subtopics: Embedded AI features across the pillars
Role-based AI agents for finance, HR and supply chain
Generative AI in documents and messages
AI Agent Studio for Fusion Applications
Security and data access for agents
days.lab_task: Use two embedded AI features, run a role-based agent on a sample task, open an agent template in AI Agent Studio and record the review steps users need.
days.deliverable: AI feature trial with review notes
checks: Two embedded AI features are used on real records
The agent completes the sample task

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Procure-to-Pay and Hire-to-Retire Walkthrough in Fusion
days.lab_task: Run procure-to-pay and hire-to-retire end to end for the course company with correct structures and roles, load sample data, and report results in OTBI.
checks: Each step is done by a user with the right role

intermediate.summary: For implementation consultants and technical developers who configure and extend Oracle Fusion. Covers implementation methodology, financials configuration and subledger accounting, order-to-cash and procure-to-pay setup, HCM configuration, payroll and compensation, security in depth, data migration at scale, HCM Extracts, Oracle Integration for Fusion, business events, advanced BI Publisher reporting, Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence, Visual Builder Studio and Redwood extensions, Application Composer, page and transaction personalisation, test automation, AI Agent Studio, environment management and certification preparation.
prerequisites: Has used Fusion as a key user or on a project
Understands Fusion enterprise structures and security
outcomes: Configure finance, procurement and HCM processes to requirements
Migrate data and build integrations, extracts and reports
Extend Fusion with Visual Builder Studio, Application Composer and AI Agent Studio
Manage environments and tests for quarterly updates and prepare for implementation exams

days.topic: Implementation Methodology: Oracle Modern Best Practice and Configuration Workbooks
days.lab_task: Run a fit-to-standard workshop for procure-to-pay with the course company personas, fill the configuration workbook and log gaps with proposed solutions.
days.deliverable: Workshop output, configuration workbook and gap log
checks: Requirements are mapped to standard processes
The workbook covers the agreed design
Gaps have proposed solutions and owners

days.topic: Financials Configuration: Chart of Accounts, Calendars and Subledger Accounting
days.lab_task: Configure a chart of accounts with hierarchies and cross-validation rules, a custom subledger accounting rule and intercompany setup, and test the accounting.
checks: The custom rule produces the expected entries

days.topic: Order-to-Cash and Procure-to-Pay Process Configuration
days.lab_task: Configure payment terms, matching tolerances, transaction types and collections for the course company and test both process flows end to end.
days.deliverable: Configured process flows with test evidence

days.topic: HCM Configuration: Grades, Jobs, Positions, Checklists and Journeys
days.lab_task: Configure grades, jobs and positions with position management, add two descriptive flexfields, build an onboarding journey and test a hire.
days.deliverable: HCM configuration with a tested hire
checks: Positions and grades follow the design
The journey runs for a new hire

days.topic: Payroll and Compensation Configuration
days.lab_task: Create earnings and deduction elements with eligibility, write a fast formula for an allowance, run a payroll flow and reconcile the results.
days.deliverable: Payroll configuration with a reconciled run
checks: Elements and eligibility work for test employees
The fast formula gives the expected allowance

days.topic: Fusion Security in Depth: Custom Roles, Data Security and the Security Console
subtopics: Area of responsibility and data roles
days.lab_task: Build a custom accountant role without payment rights, restrict an HR specialist to one country with a security profile and prove both with tests.
checks: The HR specialist sees only one country

days.topic: Data Migration with FBDI and HCM Data Loader at Scale
days.lab_task: Run a mock migration of suppliers, open invoices, customers and workers in dependency order, reconcile counts and values and triage errors.
checks: All objects load in dependency order
Counts and values match the source

days.topic: HCM Extracts and Outbound Interfaces
subtopics: Using BI Publisher templates with extracts
days.lab_task: Build a changes-only HCM Extract for a benefits provider with a BI Publisher template, schedule it and deliver it securely.
checks: The extract includes the required fields
Only changed records appear in the second run
The file is delivered securely on schedule

days.topic: Oracle Integration for Fusion: Adapters, Orchestrations and Error Handling
subtopics: The Oracle ERP Cloud and HCM adapters
days.lab_task: Build an integration that loads bank statement files into Fusion through FBDI and another that sends new workers to a badge system, with fault handling.
checks: Bank statements load through the integration
New workers reach the badge system

days.topic: Business Events, Callbacks and Event-Driven Integration
subtopics: When to use events or polling
days.lab_task: Trigger an integration from a purchase order approval event, handle a duplicate event safely and use an FBDI callback to report import results.
checks: The approval event starts the integration
A duplicate event causes no duplicate record

days.topic: Advanced Reporting: BI Publisher Data Models, Bursting and OTBI Security
subtopics: Complex data models with several data sets
days.lab_task: Build a bursting report that sends each supplier its own remittance, tune a slow data model and move both reports to another environment.
days.deliverable: Bursting report and tuned data model
checks: Each supplier gets only its remittance
The data model runs faster after tuning
Reports work in the target environment

days.topic: Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence: Prebuilt Analytics, KPIs and Data Augmentation
subtopics: When to use OTBI or Fusion Data Intelligence
days.lab_task: Build a finance dashboard from prebuilt KPIs, augment it with a budget file and compare when OTBI or Fusion Data Intelligence fits each reporting need.
days.deliverable: Analytics dashboard and tool choice guide
checks: Prebuilt KPIs show on the dashboard
Each reporting need has a tool with reasons

days.topic: Extending Fusion with Visual Builder Studio and Redwood Pages
subtopics: Source control and pipelines in Visual Builder Studio
days.lab_task: Extend a Redwood page with a new section and business rule, call a REST API for extra data and publish the extension through the pipeline.
checks: The new section and rule work on the page
The extension shows data from the API
The extension deploys through the pipeline

days.topic: Application Composer: Custom Objects, Fields and Groovy Scripts
subtopics: Groovy scripts for validation and triggers
days.lab_task: Create a custom object for supplier risk reviews with fields and a Groovy validation, add a workflow and publish it from a sandbox.
days.deliverable: Custom object with validation and workflow
checks: Invalid reviews are rejected by the script

days.topic: Personalisation with Page Composer and HCM Experience Design Studio
subtopics: Rules by role, country or business unit
days.lab_task: Create rules that require a field for one country and hide a section for one role in a hire process, and test them with two users.
checks: The field is required only for the chosen country
The section is hidden for the chosen role
Other users see the standard page

days.topic: Test Automation for Fusion: Regression Suites, Test Data and Update Cycles
days.lab_task: Automate five critical regression tests for procure-to-pay and hire, run them against a test pod and report results linked to requirements.
checks: Five tests run without manual steps
One test is updated for a changed page

days.topic: AI Agent Studio: Building and Testing Agents for Fusion Workflows
subtopics: Agent Studio concepts: agents, tools and topics
Tools that call Fusion APIs and business objects
Security and role-based access for agents
days.lab_task: Build an agent from a template that answers supplier invoice status questions with Fusion tools, test it with ten questions and deploy it to a user group.
checks: The agent uses Fusion tools to answer
At least eight of ten answers are correct
Only the intended user group can use the agent

days.topic: Environment Management: Refreshes and Configuration Set Migration
days.lab_task: Plan a refresh of the test pod, move configuration with Configuration Set Migration and setup export, and run a checklist to restore integrations after the refresh.
checks: The refresh plan lists impacts and owners

days.topic: Oracle Fusion Certification Preparation: Implementation Professional Exams
subtopics: Exam versions tied to the release year
Topics for Financials, HCM and SCM exams
Mapping course days to exam topics
days.lab_task: Choose the exam for your track, take a timed practice set, map every miss to a course day and complete a review plan.
checks: The right exam for the track is selected
A timed practice set is completed
The review plan covers weak topics

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Configured Fusion Pilot with Integrations and Reports
days.lab_task: Deliver a pilot for the course company with configured finance and HCM processes, custom security, migrated data, two integrations, an extract, a Redwood extension, reports and an agent, and present it to the steering group persona.
checks: Processes run as designed with the right roles
Integrations and extracts run without errors
Extensions, reports and the agent work for users

advanced.summary: For solution architects, programme leads and senior consultants who run large Oracle Fusion programmes. Covers programme architecture, global implementations, security architecture with segregation of duties and risk management, data migration strategy, integration architecture at scale, performance and volume, OCI extensions, agentic applications, AI governance, enterprise analytics, update governance, programme testing, change management, audit and controls, moves from E-Business Suite or SAP, third-party integration, planning and manufacturing scope, support models and a centre of excellence.
prerequisites: Has delivered at least one Fusion implementation
Understands Fusion configuration, security, integration and reporting
Responsible for design, programme or architecture decisions
outcomes: Design multi-country Fusion programmes with security, data and integration architectures
Run migrations, testing, performance work and quarterly update governance at scale
Build and govern agentic applications and analytics strategy
Lead change, controls, support and a centre of excellence

days.topic: Fusion Programme Architecture: Pillars, Integrations and Data Flows
subtopics: Solution architecture for a multi-pillar programme
Data flows between ERP, HCM and SCM
days.lab_task: Design the solution architecture for a multinational adopting ERP, HCM and SCM with its integration and reporting landscape, and defend it to a design authority.
checks: Pillars, data flows and outside systems are shown
Key decisions are recorded with options
The design authority accepts the design with actions

days.topic: Global Implementations: Localisations, Tax and Multi-Country Design
days.lab_task: Design a global template with country variations for three countries, plan tax and statutory reporting and schedule the rollout waves.
checks: Global and local elements are separated
Tax and statutory needs are covered per country
Rollout waves have dates and dependencies

days.topic: Fusion Security Architecture: Segregation of Duties and Risk Management
days.lab_task: Design the role model for the programme, define segregation of duties rules, run an analysis that finds conflicts and remediate them before go-live.
days.deliverable: Role model and conflict remediation report
checks: Roles cover all user groups with least privilege
Conflicts are found by the rules

days.topic: Data Migration Strategy for Large Programmes: Cutover, Reconciliation and Validation
days.lab_task: Write the migration strategy for the programme, plan three mock loads with timings, design reconciliations and build an hour-by-hour cutover plan.
checks: Scope, tools and quality rules are defined
The cutover plan fits the downtime window

days.topic: Integration Architecture at Scale: Oracle Integration Patterns, Monitoring and Resilience
days.lab_task: Design the integration architecture for thirty interfaces with patterns, volumes, error handling and monitoring, and run a volume test of the busiest interface.
checks: Each interface has a pattern and owner
The busiest interface handles peak volume
Failures raise alerts to the support team

days.topic: Performance and Volume: Bulk Loads, Scheduled Processes and API Limits
subtopics: Working with Oracle Support on performance
days.lab_task: Measure peak month-end loads, tune a slow scheduled process and a heavy report, and test API throughput within limits.
days.deliverable: Performance test report with tuning changes
checks: API calls stay within limits at peak

days.topic: Extending Fusion with OCI: Functions, API Gateway and Autonomous Database
subtopics: API Gateway in front of extensions
Identity and security between Fusion and OCI
days.lab_task: Build an OCI extension that scores supplier risk with a function, stores results in Autonomous Database and returns them to a Redwood page through API Gateway.
checks: Calls between Fusion and OCI are authenticated
Scores appear on the Redwood page

days.topic: Agentic Applications: Agentic Applications Builder and AI Studio Skill
subtopics: Agentic Applications Builder for business users
AI Studio Skill for pro-code developers
days.lab_task: Build an agentic application for invoice exception handling with Agentic Applications Builder, extend one step with AI Studio Skill, test it and measure time saved.
days.deliverable: Agentic application with test and value results
checks: The pro-code step works inside the application
Time saved per exception is measured

days.topic: AI Governance in Fusion: Agent Permissions, Monitoring and Responsible Use
subtopics: Permissions and data access for agents
days.lab_task: Write an AI governance policy for Fusion agents, apply permissions and approval points to two agents and review a month of seeded agent decisions.
checks: The policy defines roles, approvals and audit
Seeded decision errors are found and acted on

days.topic: Enterprise Analytics Strategy with Fusion Data Intelligence
subtopics: OTBI, BI Publisher and Fusion Data Intelligence roles
days.lab_task: Write the analytics strategy for the programme with tool roles, KPI ownership and an augmentation plan, and build one cross-pillar KPI dashboard.
checks: Each reporting need has a tool

days.topic: Quarterly Update Governance at Scale
days.lab_task: Run the update governance process for the next quarterly update across three pillars with impact analysis, risk-based regression scope and a communication plan.
checks: Users get the right change messages

days.topic: Testing and Quality at Programme Scale: SIT, UAT and Parallel Runs
days.lab_task: Write the programme test strategy, run a seeded SIT cycle, manage defects to exit criteria and assess payroll parallel run results.
checks: The strategy covers SIT, UAT and parallel runs
Defects are triaged to exit criteria

days.topic: Change Management and Adoption for Fusion Programmes
days.lab_task: Build a change impact analysis and training plan for three user groups, design the super user network and define adoption metrics for go-live.
checks: Impacts are listed per user group

days.topic: Audit, Compliance and Controls: SOX, Approvals and Audit Reports
subtopics: Advanced controls in Risk Management and Compliance
days.lab_task: Map ten financial controls to Fusion features, collect evidence for an audit walkthrough and remediate two seeded findings.
days.deliverable: Control map, evidence pack and remediation
checks: Each control maps to a feature or report
The evidence pack answers the auditor's requests

days.topic: Moving from E-Business Suite or SAP to Fusion
days.lab_task: Assess an E-Business Suite estate for a move to Fusion, decide on history, customisations and interfaces, and plan coexistence and decommissioning.
checks: History and coexistence decisions are recorded

days.topic: Fusion and Third-Party Systems: Banks, Payroll Providers and CRM
days.lab_task: Design and test interfaces with a bank, a payroll provider and a CRM, including acknowledgements and error handling, with a joint test plan.
days.deliverable: Partner interface designs with test results
checks: Each partner interface has a format and owner
Rejected files are handled and reported

days.topic: Supply Chain Planning and Manufacturing in Programme Scope
days.lab_task: Assess which planning and manufacturing modules the course company needs, run a planning scenario and a work order, and recommend scope and phasing.
checks: The planning scenario and work order run

days.topic: Managing Fusion as a Service: Support Model, Service Requests and Environment Governance
subtopics: Working with Oracle Support and service requests
Incident and problem management for Fusion
days.lab_task: Design the post-go-live support model with service levels, raise a well-formed service request for a seeded issue and set environment governance rules.
checks: Support tiers and service levels are defined
The service request has all needed details
Environment rules cover refreshes and access

days.topic: Fusion Centre of Excellence: Governance, Roadmaps and Continuous Improvement
days.lab_task: Design a Fusion centre of excellence with roles, demand intake and a twelve-month roadmap, and report value against the business case.
days.deliverable: Centre of excellence plan and value report
checks: Value is measured against the business case
objectives: Run a Fusion centre of excellence

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Fusion Programme Design for a Multinational
days.lab_task: Present the Fusion programme design for a multinational to a steering committee with the architecture, global template, security and data strategy, integrations, agentic applications, analytics, testing, change and support plans.
days.deliverable: Programme design with evidence and a steering decision
checks: Migration, testing and cutover plans are realistic
AI, update and support governance have owners
